I have reconstructed the complete Meta Canada consumer store homepage (https://www.meta.com/ca/) for the fidelity study with exact assets and specifications:

1. **Brand & Typography**:
   - Integrated the official **Optimistic VF** variable font (`https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/rsrc.php/yQ/r/-pkMfchyeAZ.woff2`) with clean system Helvetica fallbacks.
   - Exact color tokens: `#fff` body background, `#0a1317` ink, `#0457cb` primary pill buttons with 100px radius and bold white text, and `rgba(241,244,247,0.70)` secondary glass pills.

2. **Header & Region Notice**:
   - Dismissible regional selector banner (`"Did we select the right country/region? Canada"`).
   - Sticky glassmorphic navigation featuring the genuine Meta vector wordmark, links (*AI glasses*, *Meta Quest*, *Meta VR Glasses*, *Explore Meta*, *Support*), search, region selector with globe, cart bag, and account icon, plus a mobile drawer menu.

3. **Hero Experience**:
   - Embedded public video (`media_id=2468795110296160`) with separate desktop and mobile poster fallbacks.
   - Crisp DOM overlay text: `"Meet the all-new"` and `"Meta Glasses"`, accompanied by exact copy (`"More shapes. More statements. More Meta Glasses."`), official CTAs (*Shop* and *Learn more*), and a bottom-right interactive pause/play control.

4. **Category Rail & Product Showcase**:
   - Three category cards (*AI glasses*, *Meta VR Glasses*, *Meta Quest*) using official responsive media IDs.
   - All 8 full- and half-width product panels in precise order:
     1. Meta Glasses by LISA (Full width)
     2. Ray-Ban Meta (Half width)
     3. Ray-Ban Meta Audio (Half width)
     4. Meta VR Glasses (Half width)
     5. Muse Charm (Half width)
     6. Oakley Meta (Half width)
     7. Meta Ray-Ban Display (Half width)
     8. Meta Quest 3S (Full width)
   - 24px border radii, subtle gradient vignettes, and centered bottom text hierarchy.

5. **Why Buy From Meta & The Latest**:
   - Three `#f5f6f7` benefit cards with delivery, returns, and shield line icons.
   - Stacked/grid news feature cards linking to official Meta Connect and AI Glasses articles.

6. **Footer & Compliance**:
   - Newsletter sign-up row with study-disabled submission.
   - Seven responsive link groups that fold into accessible accordions on mobile viewports.
   - Full Canada (English) localization notes, official copyright, legal disclaimers, and Meta social channels.
